what: PG-pre under the stabilised recipe next to the frozen PG-pre fits; validation loss on the val states of each fit's pool; no calib or test state

notes.val loss, val_by_network: as the fit's validation computes them: per batch of 128 states a mean with the near-limit weights, the batches then averaged by their number of converged states; not one globally weighted mean per network
notes.grad_norm_before_clipping: over every optimiser step of the fit, the epochs after the selected one included
notes.median_stabilised_over_frozen: over the fits in which both recipes selected a checkpoint (ratios_over)
notes.weak: selected validation loss above weak_above, or no selected checkpoint
